targetCompanyImage.name: Union Station Data Center and Carrier Hotel
targetCompanyImage.subsector: Carrier hotel and interconnection data center
targetCompanyImage.description: Union Station Data Center & Carrier Hotel is an interconnection-focused carrier hotel in South Bend, Indiana. Its customers include telecommunication carriers, enterprises, and other network users that need access to fiber routes linking Chicago and the eastern United States. The asset follows an asset-heavy digital-infrastructure model based on owned mission-critical real estate and dense carrier interconnection infrastructure. Public acquisition materials describe the facility as a top U.S. carrier hotel with access to more than 20 telecommunications network service providers and a strategic position on transcontinental fiber routes. Harrison Street and 1547 acquired the facility in September 2024 through Harrison Street Digital Fund; the ownership split is not publicly disclosed. The investment extended the partners’ connectivity-focused platform into the South Bend market.

milestones.event: The buyers disclosed planned capacity and facility upgrades following the acquisition.
Harrison Street and 1547 announced the acquisition of the Union Station Data Center and Carrier Hotel in South Bend.
